title: An Agentic Workflow for Legacy HPC Modernization: Converting the Two-Electron-Integral Core of GAMESS
abstract: arXiv:2608.12249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modernizing legacy Fortran is a problem of volume: the transformations are individually routine, but the codebases can be enormous, and across much of computational science the work simply goes undone. We propose an agentic workflow that takes this work on at production scale, and we set out to measure how far such delegation can reach. In this work, three prompt-specialized agent roles operate under a version-controlled specification that the agents themselves authored and revised, while humans hold a small number of gates. The arrangement is kept safe by an exact verification oracle inherited from the domain, and the boundary of safe delegation lies exactly where that oracle stops seeing. translated_title: 一种用于传统高性能计算现代化的智能体工作流：转换GAMESS中的双电子积分核心
translated_abstract: 现代化传统Fortran代码的问题在于规模庞大：单个变换通常很常规，但代码库可能极其庞大，在计算科学的许多领域中，这项工作往往被搁置。我们提出了一种能够以生产规模承担此任务的智能体工作流，并旨在衡量这种委派能达到何种程度。在本工作中，三个经过提示词特化的智能体角色在由智能体自身编写和修订的版本控制规范下运作，而人类则掌握少量关键控制节点。该安排通过源自领域的精确验证预言机来确保安全，而安全委派的边界恰好位于该预言机无法覆盖之处。我们在一项案例研究中应用了所提出的工作流，将GAMESS（通用原子与分子电子结构系统）——一个拥有48年开发历史的成熟量子化学软件包——的双电子积分例程从固定格式的Fortran转换为更现代的形式。
tldr: 本文提出了一种由多个特化智能体角色协作、基于版本控制规范和精确验证预言机保障安全的智能体工作流，并成功应用于GAMESS量子化学软件的双电子积分核心代码现代化转换。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an agentic workflow with specialized agent roles, version-controlled specifications, and an exact verification oracle, successfully applied to modernize the two-electron-integral core of GAMESS.
